name: Codex weekly-only snapshot is classified by duration, not raw slot name
_comment: Observed production shape on 2026-08-02: Codex emitted only rate_limits.primary, but window_minutes was 10080 (one week). The semantic providers.codex.windows key must therefore be secondary/weekly; treating the raw primary slot as a 5h limit produces a false 5h gauge and a clock-only reset that appears to be in the past.
